method: Existing Google Cloud Translation draft with agent corrections and independent AI review; no human/native-speaker validation
notes: Independently compared all 194 fields against the frozen English source, covering marketing copy, gameplay explanations, community text, download instructions, navigation, accessibility controls and media descriptions.

Corrected globe/sphere drift to glob creature references, Mac build versus hardware model, install-step location, holding-ground/rival-map headings, source-code labels and Turkish case/possessive grammar. Reconciled native otel/yuva building names.

Verified key and placeholder parity and exact technical commands, executables and screenshot UI counters. Early-access, guest/ranked sign-in, browser-save and signing-key qualifications are preserved.
AI linguistic review only; no human/native-speaker validation. Language-specific editorial refinement may still benefit from native review.
